text:
olivia-sec: Heads-up: following the CVE review we need to accelerate TLS transit hardening across regions. Action items: RBAC for rotator keys, KMS binding audit, compat exemptions, and an EOL policy for legacy curves/ciphers. Planning an emergency canary for proxy-hardening tomorrow morning.

sam-incident: Context — customer incident this morning in APAC where a backend job failed crypto handshake after proxy autoscale landed a partial config mix. We traced to mixed tls profiles; some worker nodes had the old cipher list. We need an atomic rollout and a fast rollback.

asha-platform: Agreed. propose feature-flagged rollout and deterministic rollout order by AZ (canary AZ -> full AZ -> cross-AZ). Also implement a db-stored config-version tag on proxies so we can force a single config across active nodes before flipping.

kevin-eng: KMS constraints: rotator needs AsymmetricSign but no decrypt/export. We should create an IAM condition requiring request.auth.claims.service == "edge-cert-rotator" and request.time < key_rotation_time to prevent stale keys. Example audit filter to alert on denied calls:
```text
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign" AND
protoPayload.status.code=7
```
Trigger should page the oncall and create a CHG incident.

cert-bot: automated scan: 24 hosts in apac-e and eu-north have TLS profiles still advertising TLS1.2+RC4? (likely legacy edge boxes). Posting details to #eng-runtime. Recommend immediate patching of those boxes and adding them to the remediation queue. :rotating_light:

danielle-compliance: Compliance asks: record change rationale (CVE mapping + risk score), attach test evidence (canary telemetry), and propose rollback decision criteria. Also need to store audit snapshots for 180 days. We must not alter retention without approval.

tara-privacy: privacy check: we cannot persist raw ClientHello or UA strings linked to user ids. For telemetry keep only hashed UA prefix + curve/cipher enum + region + account id hash. ok to store counts and aggregate.

olivia-sec: rollback criteria proposal: if any of the following during 2h canary window: 1) compat-pool hit >0.7% traffic, 2) error-rate on handshake >2x baseline, 3) more than 10 unique accounts affected and at least one is production-critical -> roll back. We'll log audit snapshots at 1m granularity into compliance bucket.

asha-platform: RBAC plan: new service account edge-rotator@infra. Terraform snippet (will open PR):
```hcl
resource "google_service_account" "edge_rotator" {
  account_id = "edge-rotator"
}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "rotator_signer" {
  crypto_key_id = data.google_kms_crypto_key.rotator.self_link
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
  member        = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.edge_rotator.email}"
}
```
We'll include a condition to limit use to projects/regions. PR will include plan output.

kevin-eng: Also add an audit binding: grant logging.viewer to security-team group on the KMS key to ensure we can review AsymmetricSign calls. Add an alert on 403s and 5xxs for KMS.

cert-bot: simulated canary (edge-canary-3): applied hardened cipher list + TLS1.3 preferred for 1% traffic. Observed: handshake-failure delta = +0.12% concentrated to two UA prefixes: "LegacyMobile/" and "EdgeProxy/0.9". Both mapped to older SDKs or unmanaged proxies. Recommend targeted exemptions for UA hash + ASN for 48-72h while partners update.

san-incident: for the incident that hit earlier, mitigation path: 1) scale down new proxies, 2) pin config to last-known-good via config-version tag, 3) re-run CTL to verify handshake matrix. We need an immediate runbook step in the ops playbook.

olivia-sec: I'll update the ops playbook with one-click rollback steps and a checklist to notify partners. Will create CHG-2026 and attach canary dashboard and KMS audit sample.

danielle-compliance: Please include a short remediation timeline and owner for each exempted UA. Compliance to approve temporary exemptions not exceeding 14 days unless a remediation plan is filed.

tara-privacy: confirm telemetry schema before canary. Don't forget to hash UA with a salted HMAC keyed by internal secret.

asha-platform: infra PR ready; adding feature flag and config-version tag. Will include terraform var canary_percent and a manual promote step. cc @kevin-eng for KMS changes.

kevin-eng: I'll schedule the KMS IAM change to be applied 30m before canary and will deploy audit config. Also adding CloudAudit snapshot exporter to the compliance bucket.

cert-bot: post-change quick check: after applying RBAC + canary, no unexpected AsymmetricSign 403s seen in first 15m. compat-pool at 0.09%. Will keep monitoring and post 1h summary. :white_check_mark:

olivia-sec: timeline: KMS and RBAC done by 08:30 UTC, infra flag deploy 08:45, canary 09:00 UTC for 2h. Owners: asha (infra), kevin (kms), mike-sre (dashboard & alerts) — mike please confirm you can add the alert for compat-pool >0.7% and handshake-error >2x baseline.

mike-sre: got it. will add panels and on-call alert. will also add an automated runbook link into the alert text for fast rollback.

danielle-compliance: compliance will stand by for CHG review. Please @mention with evidence links.

olivia-sec: thanks team. follow-up: post 2h canary report in this thread and decide next step. If we see high-impact exemptions, we'll open a partner comms ticket. Backchannel in #eng-runtime for deploy logs. :thumbsup:
